# WorkBase PH

> WorkBase PH is a Philippine-based remote hiring platform that connects employers with Filipino freelancers, virtual assistants, and remote specialists. Employers pay a flat $18 to post one job — no bidding fees, no connects, no commission — and most candidates have a video and audio introduction so employers can judge communication and fit before messaging.

Key facts: flat $18 per job post (optional monthly plans: Essential $49/mo, Pro $79/mo); freelancers apply for free and keep 100% of what they earn; employers see full applicant profiles and contact details from day one (no paywall); most candidate profiles include a video and audio intro, an internet speed test, and a work-style assessment; AI smart matching surfaces relevant candidates and most employers shortlist within 24 hours; every employer is verified before posting. Roles hired include virtual assistants, executive assistants, customer support reps, bookkeepers, social media managers, and Shopify / e-commerce specialists. Launched 2026 by Curators Marketplace, DTI & BIR registered in the Philippines. Website: https://www.workbaseph.com
